parole.significato: Any of several Australian perennial herbs of the genus Typha, especially Typha domingensis and Typha orientalis.
A sweet secretion, produced by the larvae of the family Psyllidae, that forms scales on eucalyptus leaves.
A type of scrubland with low-growing thick eucalypts, characteristic of certain parts of Australia.
parole.testo: Probably borrowed from Wemba-Wemba mali; compare Woiwurrung mali.
